cards.title: CONTROLS
cards.text:
Stick: run, crouch, aim up
A: shoot   B: jump   C: grenade
In the air, aim down to fire below you.

cards.title: TIPS
cards.text:
Free the tied-up prisoners: they drop weapons, ammo and points.
Grenades run out, so save them for the big targets.

cards.title: CREDITS
cards.text:
1 COIN = 1 CREDIT
P2 JOINS ANY TIME
PRESS START
